name: The East India Company's Factory, Canton
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of the English 'factory' at Canton (Guangzhou), also known until 1833 as the East India Company 'factory', with the portico of the Dutch 'factory' visible beyond.
